text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: The results are in—it's a massive success!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Everything went according to the 
construction plan, and the facility 
upgrades went smoothly!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
In particular, the newly installed 
relaxation facility utilizing the great 
outdoors was quite well received!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
All credit goes to City for giving us that 
opinion!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Dahaha! Starting with City, all of your 
hard work has been a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"The next evaluation meeting is in late 
June! What we built has gotten even 
better!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep this momentum going and build 
even higher-level facilities!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
There's still so much we can do! We're 
gonna keep pushing full steam ahead!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the 2nd Tracen Island Evaluation 
concluded! Now, what should the next 
construction plan be...!
